about: Specs held out of every gating lane (the owner, 23 November: 'aggressively quarantine flaky tests'; scripts/test-lane.ts). A quarantined spec runs only in the optional quarantine workflow (.github/workflows/quarantine.yml), after CI has passed on main and the deploy has begun; it never fails a run. Each entry says why it flakes and what the lower-order test that replaces it would be; a spec leaves quarantine by being rewritten lower, or by being made steady and passing there run after run.

test/act-budget.test.ts.why: a wall-clock median (500 ms on CI) that a loaded runner crosses: 512 ms on run 45270018815, a docs-only commit
test/act-budget.test.ts.lower: the turn-cost ratchet's stage counts (schemas re-grounded, legs walked), not milliseconds, on push; milliseconds nightly, reported not gated
